trials.prompt:
Edit the supplied original illustration in place, preserving its artwork, 16:9 framing, layout and anime identities. Deep mode means visibly stronger SHADING AND LIGHT RESPONSE, while color saturation stays close to this source. This is the same illustrated ensemble, not a replacement scene.
Preserve the eight main figures and two tiny distant figures, every expression and pose, hair and costume designs, hand gestures, jewelry and emblems, the curling parchment ribbon, central garden, balloons, feathers, fireworks, stars and musical staves. Do not add or remove subjects or scenery. Do not beautify, change anatomy or make anime faces photorealistic.
Light direction: the existing pale luminous central garden and illuminated parchment act as broad soft bounce; the already-glowing musical arcs give gentle cyan edge light. Make the light-facing planes of the parchment luminous champagne ivory and leave unlit parchment beige/tan, with substantially deeper but readable shadows underneath its existing overlaps. Give the existing characters more dimensional yet clean shading: soft warm-neutral highlights, clearly shaped shadowed sides and contact shadows under existing hair, cloth folds, jewelry and overlaps. Differentiate matte fabric, restrained satin sheen and small existing metallic specular highlights. Keep edges and ornament outlines sharp, with localized glow only at existing emissive lines and luminous cores. Stronger light-and-shadow separation must be visible at full image size.
COLOR PRIORITY: preserve the original image's color intensity. Dark navy sky remains muted navy, never electric cobalt. Parchment remains beige/ivory, never saturated orange. White clothes stay neutral ivory/white, not yellow or cyan. Skin stays source-faithful. Existing blue dresses use restrained blue-gray shadow tones, not intensely saturated royal blue. Keep the original vivid colors where they already exist; reduce neither the whole image to gray nor all its colors uniformly. Confine subtle colored bounce to surfaces reached by the original lights. Obtain the clear uplift through luminance, occlusion, broad form shading and material highlights, not boosted vibrance or a complementary-color filter.
Keep clean anime linework and source texture vocabulary. No new pores, decorative patterns, extra particles, planets, fog, background reconstruction, palette replacement, global bloom veil, blur, paint smear, black crush, clipping or sharpening halos. Match all source silhouettes and face feature positions as closely as possible. Deliver one complete edited illustration without labels or comparison layout.
